description: Closed-form configurations and strata of the cap-discrepancy minimizers for N = 1..4 (sphcap/gram.py), written by jobs/atlas_small_n.py --write-input; the raw source of the atlas observations of N = 1..4. Coordinates are double precision; Gram matrices are exact (Q or Q(sqrt k), as strings); values and tags labelled "proved (manuscript)" rest on the hand proofs of the unpublished manuscript.

classes.name: N1_point
classes.drawn_by: the configuration space modulo rotations is one point; any point represents it

classes.name: N3_generic
classes.drawn_by: a = arccos(-1/3), b = arccos(-1/4): a generic point (arcs pairwise distinct, all > g*)

classes.name: N3_equilateral
classes.drawn_by: the equilateral triple a = b = c = 2 pi/3

classes.name: N3_edge
classes.drawn_by: a = g*, b = arccos(-1/3): a generic point of the edge a = g* (b, c distinct, > g*)

classes.name: N3_fold_larger
classes.drawn_by: arcs (s, 2 pi - 2s, s) with s = arccos(-1/3): two equal arcs, the third larger

classes.name: N3_fold_smaller
classes.drawn_by: arcs (s, t, t) with s = 2 arccos(3/5), t = pi - s/2: two equal arcs, the third smaller

classes.name: N3_edge_midpoint
classes.drawn_by: a = g*, b = c = pi - g*/2: the midpoint of an edge

classes.name: N3_corner_1
classes.drawn_by: corner 1 of the parameter region (two arcs equal to g*); the three corners are relabellings of one configuration

classes.name: N3_corner_2
classes.drawn_by: corner 2 of the parameter region (two arcs equal to g*); the three corners are relabellings of one configuration

classes.name: N3_corner_3
classes.drawn_by: corner 3 of the parameter region (two arcs equal to g*); the three corners are relabellings of one configuration

classes.name: N4_arc_end_symmetric
classes.drawn_by: N4_ARC_END_SYMMETRIC of sphcap/gram.py: x = (13 - sqrt 105)/32, y = z = (19 + sqrt 105)/64

classes.name: N4_arc_end_edge
classes.drawn_by: N4_ARC_END_EDGE of sphcap/gram.py: x = (14 - sqrt 70)/64, y = (14 + sqrt 70)/64, z = 9/16

classes.name: N4_arc_z_15_32
classes.drawn_by: interior point of the arc at z = 15/32 (x < y the roots of t^2 - (1 - z) t + z (1 - z)/(16 z - 1))

classes.name: N4_arc_z_1_2
classes.drawn_by: interior point of the arc at z = 1/2 (x < y the roots of t^2 - (1 - z) t + z (1 - z)/(16 z - 1))

classes.name: N4_arc_z_17_32
classes.drawn_by: interior point of the arc at z = 17/32 (x < y the roots of t^2 - (1 - z) t + z (1 - z)/(16 z - 1))

variables.name: a, b, c
variables.meaning: the arcs x_0 x_1, x_1 x_2, x_2 x_0 along the great circle (radians), a + b + c = 2 pi

variables.name: G_ij
variables.meaning: <x_i, x_j>; G_01 = cos a, G_12 = cos b, G_20 = cos c
